snippet.title: Empyreal - Streamer Reactions Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Empyreal is a complex, challenging, feature-rich action RPG. In a far-flung corner of the galaxy an Expedition arrives on a hitherto unexplored planet to find a colossal Monolith built by a lost civilisation.
